notes.title: The game "Alas" begins open beta testing.
notes.notes:
After nearly a month of closed testing, we have fixed most of the bugs submitted by players and completely replaced the art assets.

Now we believe it is time to start open beta testing~
(Please note: this is still a test, it's free, there will be data wipes, and various bugs are expected. We highly welcome everyone to report bugs, opinions, and suggestions in our QQ group or on Discord.)

This game is a hybrid of vampire-like elements and card gameplay. As an avid player of both genres, I often wondered if combining them would create a unique experience. Of course, this is a challenging task, and even now, I feel that the fusion isn't quite perfect yet. Therefore, your valuable feedback after experiencing the game would be greatly appreciated.

Lastly, I want to mention that we chose the story from Journey to the West where Sun Wukong's lifespan has ended, he is captured and brought to the underworld for judgment by King Yama, but he breaks out of his cell, kicks away all the demons, erases his name from the Book of Life and Death, and defies fate, achieving freedom. I hope to convey such feelings in future updates of the game.

I also wish everyone success in defying their own destinies like the Great Sage Equal to Heaven. My life is mine to control, not heaven's.

Deep Snow Studio
Deep Sea Big Cat
